name: md2wechat
tagline_zh: Markdown 秒变公众号推文，自动配图、生成草稿、去AI味，还附标题灵感。排版不用再求人，复制粘贴就完事。
tagline_en: Turn Markdown into WeChat posts in one go—auto images, drafts, de-AI text, and title ideas. No more layout begging.
desc_en: Convert Markdown to WeChat Official Account HTML, inspect supported providers/themes/prompts, generate article images, create drafts, write with creator styles, prepare title suggestions, and remove AI writing traces.
why_zh: 别家只转格式，它连草稿和配图都包了，还能抹掉AI腔，省下的是你来回改稿的半小时。
why_en: Others just convert; this one drafts, images, and de-AIs your text—saving you half an hour of fiddling.
